title: Attendee map overlay
description: The only contract between producers (import script, a future editor, the layout planner) and the viewer. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored by the viewer.

shortName.description: Tab label; falls back to name.

background.description: Path relative to the site root. Stretched to fill width x height.

backgroundHighlight.description: Optional. Same size as background, in full colour. Shown only inside highlighted shapes, so the background can be a muted version.

labels.description: Optional. Printed labels/pins drawn above everything. Best as an SVG whose top-level <g> holds groups tagged data-i="<item ids>" (an item's own label/pin), data-sel="<item id>" (shown only while that item is selected) or class="chrome" (title, legend: always faint), with colours as classes the file's own <style> gives grey (.off) and dark (svg.dark) versions; see README. While something is selected, the other groups turn grey and faded. A picture (png/webp/jpg) also works: it fades as a whole while something is selected.

dark.description: Optional. Dark-mode versions of the pictures above (same size). The viewer uses them when the page is dark; a missing one falls back to the light picture.

labels.description: Only for a picture of the labels; an SVG labels file recolours itself (svg.dark).

color.description: Optional. Floor colour: bar next to that floor's rooms in the room list and search results.

icon.description: Name from the viewer's built-in icon set; unknown names show a dot.

floor.description: Optional: selecting this category switches to this floor.

link.description: Optional. Word used after ?cat= in shareable links (e.g. 'hungry' for food). Links with the category id keep working. Never reuse a word for something else once links are out.

oldLinks.description: Optional. Ids and link words of categories merged into this one, so ?cat= links already shared keep working (e.g. 'org-fair', 'curious' on fairs).

chip.description: false = no chip in the category bar (still searchable).

chipWith.description: Optional. Id of another category whose chip also shows this one (lifts on the stairs chip). This category gets no chip of its own; both are highlighted in their own colours and the card has a line for each.

cardList.description: Optional. true = the category's card lists every item by name with its floor (Fairs & booths), instead of a count.

chipLabel.description: Optional. Chip text when other categories join this chip (e.g. 'Stairs & lifts'); default: label.

marker.description: false = selecting an item draws no marker (the plan prints its own pin there, e.g. meeting points); the ripple plays round the printed pin instead.

aliases.description: Optional. Extra search words for every item of this category (e.g. 'WC', 'elevator').

icon.description: Optional. This item's own icon instead of its category's (the fairs: booth, flask, diamond).

color.description: Optional. This item's own colour (marker, highlight, icon) instead of its category's.

order.description: Optional. Position in a cardList category's card (smaller first); default after the numbered ones, by floor.

mapNote.description: Optional. A short line the viewer writes under the item's printed label (last labelBoxes entry), e.g. opening hours.

labelBoxes.description: Optional. Where this item's printed label/pin sits in the floor's labels image: [x, y, width, height].

shapes.description: Optional, instead of or in addition to shape: several areas for one item (e.g. 'Nap Rooms' = four rooms).

links.description: Optional. Buttons on the item's card that open a web page (e.g. directions to the entrance).

connects.description: Optional, for stairs and lifts: ids of the other floors it goes to ([] = none). Shown as 'Goes to …' on the card and as a badge on stairs; used by 'How to get here' to pick the right ones.

id.description: Opaque, stable. Used in deep links and printed QR codes: never change once published.
